description: A rectangular room's square feet, square meters, square yards and perimeter from its length and width in feet and inches, plus wall area and volume when the ceiling height is given. A foot is exactly 0.3048 meters. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

ceiling_ft.description: Ceiling height in feet, for wall area and volume. Default 8; 0 to leave out.

title: Room dimensions calculator
